target.text:
morphogenesis — The process by which a structure takes shape from local interactions rather than from a blueprint. The question is not what the shape is but what rule makes it appear.
target 28x28 · 0.36 of cells alive
empty-grid error 0.1788 — the denominator of every match score below

rule.text:
update rule — The function applied to every cell at every step. Here it is a small convolutional network, and it is the only thing that is learned — everything the grid does over time is this one function repeated.
4,704 parameters — one rule, shared by every cell
12 channels per cell: 4 are RGBA, 8 are unconstrained
